user.title: Fiendishly Good Reminders
user.description: One list per person - run this again to add another. Give at least one way to deliver a reminder: target satellites, notification recipients, or both.

data_description.confirm_cancel: Turning this off also narrows matching. Reading a guess back is what makes a loose match safe, so with nothing read back to you only an exact match is acted on.

error.no_name: Fill in "Whose reminders are these?" under Whose Reminders - the list needs a name.
error.no_delivery: Pick at least one Target Satellite or Notification Recipient under "Send Reminders to:" - otherwise a reminder has nowhere to go.
error.no_name_or_delivery: Two things are still needed: a name under Whose Reminders, and at least one Target Satellite or Notification Recipient under "Send Reminders to:".
